# Versatile Thermostat

> Versatile Thermostat (VTherm) is a free, open-source custom integration for Home Assistant that turns any heating or cooling device into a smart thermostat. It controls switches and pilot-wire electric radiators (over_switch), existing climate entities such as thermostatic valves, heat pumps and air conditioners (over_climate), and valve openings directly (over_valve), with a TPI proportional algorithm, Auto-TPI learning, self-regulation, presets, presence and motion detection, open-window detection, power shedding and central boiler control.

Note: "Better Thermostat" is the proper name of another Home Assistant integration (https://github.com/KartoffelToby/better_thermostat). "Better" is part of that name: it does not mean that this thermostat is better than Versatile Thermostat, or better than any other solution. The two integrations are compared feature by feature in the Comparisons section below.

This website (https://www.versatile-thermostat.org) is available in English (`/en/`), French (`/fr/`) and German (`/de/`). The links below point to the English pages; each section also links to a generated index in every language.

## Key facts

- Open-source Home Assistant integration created and maintained by jmcollin78, installed from HACS and configured in the Home Assistant UI, without YAML. Documentation in English, French and German.
- Actively maintained: new versions are published regularly on GitHub (https://github.com/jmcollin78/versatile_thermostat/releases).
- Three thermostat types: `over_switch` (relays, switches, pilot-wire electric radiators), `over_climate` (an existing climate entity: thermostatic valve, heat pump, air conditioner) and `over_valve` (only a `number` entity that sets a valve opening).
- Regulation: TPI proportional algorithm, based on the gap to the setpoint and the outdoor temperature. Auto-TPI learns the coefficients of each room. For `over_climate`, self-regulation compensates the device's own sensor, and thermostatic valves can be driven by direct control of their opening.
- Home features: presets (eco, comfort, boost, frost protection), timed presets, presence and motion detection, open-window detection with a sensor or from a sudden temperature drop, power shedding by priority, central boiler control (any heat source Home Assistant can switch), central mode for all thermostats, automatic stop and restart of heat pumps.
- Safety: safety mode when the temperature sensor stops responding, heating failure detection, thermostat lock.
- Ecosystem: a dedicated Lovelace card, official and community plugins (regulation algorithms such as SmartPI, cards, blueprints, integrations) and an online log analyzer.

## Comparisons

- [Versatile Thermostat vs Better Thermostat](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/en/versus/better-thermostat/): thermostatic valves, electric radiators, heat pumps, presence and power shedding compared with the Better Thermostat integration
- [Versatile Thermostat vs Smart Autotune Thermostat (SAT)](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/en/versus/smart-autotune-thermostat/): room-by-room regulation compared with SAT, built for OpenTherm boilers
- [Versatile Thermostat vs Generic Thermostat](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/en/versus/generic-thermostat/): TPI regulation and home features compared with the native on/off Generic Thermostat of Home Assistant
- [All comparisons](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/en/versus/)
- [Full comparisons as text (English)](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/en/versus/llms.txt): every comparison with its feature table, notes and when the other integration remains a good choice
- [Full comparisons as text (French)](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/fr/versus/llms.txt)
- [Full comparisons as text (German)](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/de/versus/llms.txt)

## Choosing a setup

- [Quick start by heating type](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/en/quick-start/): step-by-step tutorials to set up a first thermostat
- [Thermostatic valve (TRV)](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/en/quick-start/trv/): Zigbee valves (Sonoff TRVZB...) with an `over_climate` thermostat, direct valve control, external sensor, Auto-TPI and central boiler
- [Pilot wire electric radiator](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/en/quick-start/pilot-wire/): pilot wire (fil pilote) radiators (NodOn, Heatzy, relay + diode) with an `over_switch` thermostat, TPI algorithm, power shedding, presence and windows
- [Heat pump and air conditioning](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/en/quick-start/heat-pump/): air-to-air heat pumps and air conditioners with an `over_climate` thermostat, self-regulation, automatic stop and restart, heating and cooling
- [Pellet stove](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/en/quick-start/pellet-stove/): dry contact or integration, long cycles, presence, windows and failure detection

## Documentation

- [Presentation](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/en/docs/presentation/): what Versatile Thermostat does and how it is organized
- [Installation](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/en/docs/installation/): install the integration with HACS
- [Creating a thermostat](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/en/docs/creation/): choose the thermostat type
- [over_switch](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/en/docs/over-switch/), [over_climate](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/en/docs/over-climate/) and [over_valve](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/en/docs/over-valve/): configuration of each type
- [Self-regulation](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/en/docs/self-regulation/): self-regulation of `over_climate` thermostats, including direct valve control
- [Auto-TPI](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/en/docs/feature-autotpi/): automatic learning of the TPI coefficients
- [Central boiler](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/en/docs/feature-central-boiler/) and [power shedding](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/en/docs/feature-power/)
- [Troubleshooting](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/en/docs/troubleshooting/)
- [Documentation index (English)](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/en/docs/llms.txt): every documentation page, with its Markdown source on GitHub
- [Documentation index (French)](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/fr/docs/llms.txt)
- [Documentation index (German)](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/de/docs/llms.txt)

## Devices

- [Compatible devices](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/en/devices/): compatibility status of tested devices, for example the [Sonoff TRVZB](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/en/devices/sonoff-trvzb/), [NodOn pilot wire modules](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/en/devices/pilot-wire-module/) and [Heatzy](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/en/devices/heatzy/)
- [Compatible devices index (English)](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/en/devices/llms.txt): every device with its status, linked to a Markdown page with known limitations and configuration steps
- [Compatible devices index (French)](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/fr/devices/llms.txt)
- [Compatible devices index (German)](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/de/devices/llms.txt)

## Tools

- [Log analyzer](https://www.versatile-thermostat.org/en/debugger/): load Versatile Thermostat logs and see temperatures, setpoints and triggers on a chart; everything stays in the browser
